description: One query in a `!` body plus one in the non-`!` helper it calls, against a real SQLite: move(6) fails after both writes (rolled back, the helper's included), move(1) succeeds — 2 rows persist (4 without the envelope, 3 if it did not reach the helper).
rationale: §8.9.2 amendment S473: "The implicit-envelope trigger above is therefore read over the function's transitive query set: every `?{}` reached from the `!` body — its own and those of every non-`!` function it reaches". Ruling user-voice-scrml.md S473 "the transitive `!` envelope counts QUERIES, not writes".
